# MRPS Agent Toolkit
> A curated collection of open-source tools and agent skills for coding agents.

This directory indexes verified open-source developer tools, CLI utilities, libraries, and agent skills. Every entry links to upstream sources and provides strict operational boundaries for coding agents.

## Core Documents
- [Agent Guidance](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/AGENTS.md): Operational protocols, permissions ladder, and honesty rules.
- [Capability Index](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/index.json): Machine-readable index of all capabilities.
- [Project Credits](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/CREDITS.md): Full attribution, repositories, and licenses.

## Tools
- [MRPS Agent Launcher](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/mrps-agent-runner.html): Read-only project auditor and runner for code, security, a11y, and UI checks. Category: orchestration. Kind: skill. License: MIT.
- [Impeccable](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/impeccable.html): The design vocabulary and UI critique system for coding agents. Category: ui-ux. Kind: skill. License: Apache-2.0.
- [Obscura](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/obscura.html): High-performance Rust-based headless browser for AI agents and web scraping. Category: testing. Kind: app. License: Apache-2.0.
- [Playwright](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/playwright.html): Reliable end-to-end multi-browser testing framework for modern web applications. Category: testing. Kind: library. License: Apache-2.0.
- [axe-core](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/axe-core.html): Automated accessibility testing engine for HTML and web applications. Category: accessibility. Kind: library. License: MPL-2.0.
- [Trivy](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/trivy.html): Comprehensive security scanner for vulnerabilities, secrets, and misconfigurations. Category: security. Kind: cli. License: Apache-2.0.
- [Graphify](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/graphify.html): Codebase knowledge graph generator with deterministic AST parsing. Category: code-analysis. Kind: skill. License: Apache-2.0.
- [REA](https://mrps.in/agent-toolkit/tools/rea.html): Universal reverse engineering MCP server for binaries, runtimes, and application behavior. Category: reverse-engineering. Kind: mcp-server. License: MIT.
